commit.author: Timo Sulg <timgluz@gmail.com>

lines.content: - Confirmed existing Vite-based site (`npm run build:check`) still builds successfully, completely unaffected by the new `astro.config.mjs`/deps sitting alongside it — safe to keep iterating incrementally without breaking the live site mid-migration.
- Cleaned up: removed the throwaway spike page and Playwright script, stopped `astro dev`/`astro preview` processes, removed `dist/`/`.astro/` build output, added `.astro` to `.gitignore`.
- Surviving changes on the branch after Phase 0: `teeline-web/astro.config.mjs` (new), `astro`+`@astrojs/preact` added to `package.json`/`package-lock.json`, `.gitignore` updated.
- Next: Phase 1 (scaffold + config) — full `astro.config.mjs` with `@astrojs/sitemap`/`@astrojs/rss`, standalone `vitest.config.ts`, `src/nav-data.ts` extraction, delete `vite.config.ts`.

- Committed Phase 0 as `f8923a1` and opened draft PR [#358](https://github.com/timgluz/teeline/pull/358) (branch `feat/teeline-web-astro7-migration`, off fresh `master` which already includes the merged #357 pipeline endpoint).
- **Phase 1 (scaffold + config) — mostly done, one deviation from the plan, one blocker discovered:**

- Added `@astrojs/sitemap` to `astro.config.mjs` integrations. `@astrojs/rss` installed as a dependency but not wired to a route yet (no blog collection exists until Phase 2/7 — the `src/pages/rss.xml.js` route file comes with the blog work).

- Created standalone `vitest.config.ts` (moved the `test: { include: ['src/**/*.test.ts'] }` block out of `vite.config.ts`, which Vitest picks up automatically since a dedicated `vitest.config.ts` takes priority). Verified: all 208 existing tests still pass unchanged.

- Extracted `src/nav-data.ts` from `src/nav-html.mjs`'s data (`SOLVER_META`/`SOLVER_GROUPS`/`PAGED_SOLVERS`), as a plain framework-agnostic TS module — plus a new `EXPLAINER_SOLVERS` set (previously an implicit `existsSync()` check in `build-docs.mjs`, now explicit). **Includes `stochastic_hill` as an 18th entry** (group: "Local search", matching its own doc's `**Type**: Heuristic — local search` badge) per the user's decision to include it now. Added `src/nav-data.test.ts` (10 tests, same assertions as the existing `nav-html.test.ts` pattern, adjusted for 18 solvers). `nav-html.mjs` itself is untouched and still in use by the live Vite site (`ssr-nav-html` plugin, `docs-init.ts`) — the two data sources intentionally diverge until cutover, when `nav-html.mjs` is deleted and `Topbar.astro`/`Sidebar.astro` (Phase 3/4) become the only consumers of `nav-data.ts`.

- **Deviated from the plan's literal Phase 1 scope**: did NOT delete `vite.config.ts` or switch `package.json`'s `dev`/`build`/`build:check`/`preview` scripts over to `astro` yet. Reasoning: no Astro pages exist yet (`src/pages/` is empty after removing the Phase 0 spike page), so flipping the scripts now would make `npm run dev`/`build` serve/build an empty site with zero routes, breaking local dev and CI for every commit between now and Phase 3–6 (when real pages land). Keeping `vite.config.ts` and the current scripts alive until Astro's pages are a genuine drop-in replacement avoids a multi-day period of broken builds on this branch. Astro is developed/tested via `npx astro dev`/`astro build`/`astro preview` directly in the meantime. Will delete `vite.config.ts` and flip the scripts together in the Phase 9/10 (CI/CD + cutover) window instead of Phase 1, once pages actually exist to serve.

- **New blocker discovered**: `astro check` (needed for `.astro` template type-checking, since bare `tsc` doesn't check `.astro` files) **refuses to run against TypeScript 7** — `@astrojs/language-server` explicitly detects TS 7's native compiler doesn't yet expose the programmatic API it needs and throws: *"TypeScript's native compiler (7.0 and later) does not ship this API yet... run astro check with a TypeScript version that still provides it (6.x)."* Tracked upstream: https://github.com/withastro/roadmap/discussions/1321. This is unrelated to `--legacy-peer-deps`/npm resolution — it's a genuine runtime capability gap, not a version-pin nitpick. Uninstalled `@astrojs/check` (nothing to gain carrying a devDependency that can't function). **Open decision, not yet resolved** — one of:

1. Skip `astro check` entirely for this migration; rely on `tsc --noEmit` (catches `.ts`/`.tsx` errors, not `.astro` template prop-type mismatches) plus Playwright/manual QA to catch `.astro`-specific bugs. Lowest friction, matches "don't block on tooling gaps" bias.

2. Downgrade `typescript` from `7.0.2` to `^6.x` project-wide so `astro check` works — real regression on an already-adopted TS7 pin, affects the whole project not just teeline-web, needs explicit sign-off before doing this.

3. Wait for upstream Astro/TS tooling to add TS7 support before finishing the migration — indefinite timeline, blocks progress for no clear win given `.astro` files are a small fraction of the codebase.

Current default (pending user input): **option 1** — proceeding without `astro check` in scripts/CI, `tsc --noEmit` stays as the type-safety gate. `package.json` scripts (Phase 9/10) will use `"build": "tsc --noEmit && astro build && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs"` (no `astro check` step) unless the user picks a different option.
- Verified: `npx vitest run` (208 tests), `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean), and `npm run build:check` (existing Vite site, unaffected) all still pass after these changes.
- Next: Phase 2 (content collections) — `src/content/config.ts`, frontmatter codemod across the 18 `docs/algorithms/*.md` files (including `stochastic-hill.md`), one placeholder blog post.
## Blockers
## Blockers
None. Phase 0 go/no-go gate passed — safe to proceed to Phase 1.

- **`astro check` cannot run against TypeScript 7** (see Phase 1 log above) — not blocking overall migration progress, but the user should confirm the default of "skip `astro check`, rely on `tsc --noEmit`" is acceptable, or pick an alternative, before Phase 9/10 finalizes CI scripts.

commit.message:
Log Phase 1 progress + astro-check/TS7 blocker for Astro 7 migration

Sitemap integration added, standalone vitest.config.ts, nav-data.ts
extracted (incl. stochastic_hill as 18th solver). Deviated from plan's
literal Phase 1 scope: kept vite.config.ts + existing npm scripts alive
until Astro pages exist, to avoid breaking the site mid-migration.
Discovered astro check cannot run against TypeScript 7 — flagged as an
open decision point, defaulting to tsc --noEmit only for now.

Implements [[tasks/teeline-web-astro7-migration]]
